status_reason: M6-P0 interface contract fixes, strict acceptance checker upgrades, and four synthetic counterexample regressions are complete and locally verified. P1 cluster execution remains BLOCKED pending owner approval for environment creation, approved fixtures, pre-validated mini indexes, and Slurm submissions.

p0_resigned_specifications.title: Strict dual-route completeness requirement for M6 sign-off
p0_resigned_specifications.detail: check-upstream-acceptance now defaults to --require-both-routes=True. Any sign-off missing either bulk (salmon) or scRNA (starsolo) exits non-zero and explicitly records missing_routes.

p0_resigned_specifications.title: Salmon quant.sf finite check and exact integer reconciliation
p0_resigned_specifications.detail: check_salmon_quant_reconciliation verifies that every sample has an existing, non-empty quant.sf, with finite NumReads, and verifies that round(NumReads) exactly matches counts_raw.tsv across all features. Mismatches, missing files, or NaN/Inf values strictly fail.

p0_resigned_specifications.title: STARsolo deep entry-level Matrix Market inspection across all samples
p0_resigned_specifications.detail: check_10x_directory inspects every coordinate and count entry across all declared samples (not just the header). It verifies declared nnz entry count, coordinate bounds [1..n_features] and [1..n_barcodes], finite non-negative integer values, and presence of positive non-zero signal. Missing filtered directories for any sample fail.

p0_resigned_specifications.title: Downstream runtime execution evidence and strict boolean gate
p0_resigned_specifications.detail: check_downstream_consumed requires valid run_id and ISO generated_at timestamp, matching input SHA-256 checksums for all expected inputs, verified positive actual dimensions (n_cells/n_genes or n_samples/n_genes), and strictly requires delivery_allowed to be boolean False (omitted, string, or True values fail).

counterexample_regressions.target: Single route attempting to sign off M6
Salmon quant.sf reconciliation mismatch, missing file, or NaN values
counterexample_regressions.defect_result: FAILED (exit code 1, reported quant_reconciliation, quant_sf_present, or values_finite)
counterexample_regressions.valid_control_result: PASSED (exit code 0, payload['status'] == 'pass', all features verified)

counterexample_regressions.target: STARsolo header nnz mismatch, negative/float values, all-zero signal, or missing sample filtered dir
counterexample_regressions.defect_result: FAILED (exit code 1, reported entry_count_matches_nnz, values_integer_nonnegative, nonzero_signal, or upstream:S2)
counterexample_regressions.valid_control_result: PASSED (exit code 0, payload['status'] == 'pass', all samples and entries verified)

counterexample_regressions.target: Downstream missing runtime binding (run_id), checksum mismatch, missing dims, or non-boolean delivery_allowed
counterexample_regressions.defect_result: FAILED (exit code 1, reported downstream_runtime_binding, downstream_input_checksum, downstream_actual_dimensions, or delivery_allowed_boolean_false)
counterexample_regressions.valid_control_result: PASSED (exit code 0, payload['status'] == 'pass', runtime evidence verified, delivery_allowed is False)
